Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MSFT.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 939 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2019.
We generated $7.2 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 9% to 20% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We generated $7.2 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 29 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
